lead: A goal record's `command` check's `want` is an *ordered* list, so two names in it assert an order as much as a presence.
body: `nvs schema dump`'s wanted `nvs_jobs` before `nvs_dead_jobs`, which no server answers: every catalog query in `nvs_db::catalog` orders by table name, so the dump is alphabetical and the check read as unwritten work forever. Before writing output to satisfy a `want`, ask whether the order it names is one the data can have — and when it is not, fix the `want` and say in the goal's prose which ordering is real.
